name: Azeroth Companion
title: Official Icon Stability & Safe Worker Integration
features: Prevent repeated DOM writes for absent spell icons and reduce needless tree mutation cycles on PC and iPhone.
Preserve all v5.4 talent and gear source comparisons, saved drafts, and v5.3 draggable atlas.
Provide explicit minimal Cloudflare Worker patch instructions, backup and rollback plan without overwriting personal portal scripts.
Live spell icons require a separate Cloudflare owner deployment; publishing GitHub Pages does not update the Worker.
Keep client OAuth secrets and private sessions server-side; no made-up talent data or stat values.
